## zipzi.values.Appearance

```python
class Appearance(Value)
```

Opacity and RGB color factors applied to an object or shape.

| Field | Type | Constructor default (wire JSON) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `opacity` | `float` | Required | Finite nonnegative opacity factor; 0 is transparent and 1 is opaque. Imported values<br>above 1 are retained without clamping. |
| `multiply` | `tuple[float, ...]` | Required | RGB multiply factors in channel order R, G, B; (1, 1, 1) is neutral. |
| `screen` | `tuple[float, ...]` | Required | RGB screen factors in channel order R, G, B; (0, 0, 0) is neutral. |
